ash: Handoff from Ash — quick ops standup.
ash: What I did: scaled eu-west1 embed pool x2, manually forced KV cache warmup, set regeneration-priority to LOW for requests > 8k tokens to reduce pressure.
ash: Blockers: one GPU host in eu-west1 (gw-17) hitting high GPU memory and reporting OOM traces; can't repro on staging. Need node drain or host reboot.
ash: Today / next steps: validate eviction rates for 30m, enable small-model fallthrough for affected routes, coordinate host remediation with infra. Uploaded logs + profile snapshot to artifacts: https://artifacts.company/reports/2850012345
cam: Can you paste the pod logs for gw-17 here? If it's OOM we should drain and cordon. I can take the drain if you give the green light.
ash: Logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T12:34:22Z kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4123 (inference) score 987
inference[4123]: kv_cache_alloc failed: requested 1.2G, available 512M
```
ash: Full logs uploaded at the artifacts link above.
oncall-bot: Incident #452 status update: severity lowered to SEV3 after capacity scale and routing fallbacks applied. Monitors still in watch state.
li: Note — I rolled out routing policy v2 at 12:14 UTC: if queue latency > 250ms for 5s, route to small-v2 fallthrough. Keep an eye on error budget and 95th pct latency.
sasha: I'll take host remediation for gw-17, starting cordon+drain now. ETA ~15m. Will report back when node is out of service. :white_check_mark:
cam: Quick CR ping — PR #9877 (kvcache: eviction backpressure tweak) is blocking autoscaler patch. @li can you review? It's two small changes and one unit test.
li: Yep, I'll review in ~20m. If it's green, we can roll to canary tonight.
ops-scheduler: Scheduled reminder: follow-up post-check at 12:50 UTC to confirm eviction rates normalized.
ash: Summary / actions: 1) sasha draining node gw-17 2) keep small-v2 fallthrough enabled 3) li to review PR #9877 4) ash to check eviction graph at +30m and decide on revert if latency spikes. Ping me for any escalations. :thinking:
sasha: Node drained and reprovisioned host marked for maintenance. Observability shows drop in memory pressure after drain. Will keep the node offline until patch applied.
cam: Once li approves PR, I'll kick the autoscaler canary. If anything changes I'll update this thread.
ash: Thanks everyone — I'll close handoff after the 12:50 check. If you need me I'm on zoom and pager.
